Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our discovery:

- What we heard: primary goal is to reduce inference latency for your streaming ranking pipeline and cut per-token cost while keeping model quality stable. Tight SLOs for 95th pct latency (~120ms).
- Key constraints: on-prem data residency for user signals, existing feature stores, and a single-region failover requirement.
- Must-have attendees for the next session: your ML infra lead + SRE (to validate networking/KV cache assumptions), plus product manager for acceptance criteria.

We recommend a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (hands-on architecture + ops checklist). Availability from our side: the week of Aug 22 — 25 PT. Can you do a 60–90m block on any of those days? If helpful, we can propose two concrete times and lock one.

Agenda we suggest (we can tailor):
- 5m: introductions & goals
- 15m: high-level architecture discussion (models, traffic shape, SLOs)
- 30m: runtime deep-dive (batching, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs)
- 20m: ops/runbook & fallback policies (failover, monitoring)
- 10m: next steps & owners

Attached: post-call-notes.pdf (short bullet recap).

If you can confirm attendees and 2 candidate slots I’ll get the calendar invite out and include our ML/infra engineer (Marissa) and Ben (Customer Lead).

Thanks,
Priya
